doctrines.name: U.S.-Person PII Entering Operating Picture Without Minimization
doctrines.description: Detects U.S.-person identifiers (SSN, full name + DOB, passport, phone, street address) flowing from a source feed into the common operating picture without on-ingest tokenization. Enforces privacy / civil-liberties minimization for U.S.-person information.

doctrines.name: Caveated Record Released Across Sovereignty Boundary
doctrines.description: Rejects release of NOFORN, ORCON, or U.S.-person-tagged records to a partner-nation or foreign-controlled network. Enforces that caveated and U.S.-only data remains under U.S. Government authority at all times.

doctrines.name: Data Written to Endpoint Outside U.S. Government Authority
doctrines.description: Detects writing or syncing operational data to an endpoint not present in the signed sovereign manifest (foreign cloud, unregistered tenant, or out-of-band host).

doctrines.name: Classification Marking or Caveat Stripped
doctrines.description: Rejects mutations that remove classification banners or dissemination caveats from a record in order to downgrade or launder it past release controls.

doctrines.name: Predictive Model Ingesting Raw U.S.-Person Data
doctrines.description: Blocks an AI/ML predictive-analytics agent from reading raw, un-minimized U.S.-person records before the privacy / civil-liberties gate has tokenized them. Models may only train or infer over minimized data.

doctrines.name: Interdiction Cue Without Signed Authorization
doctrines.description: Rejects an interdiction or targeting cue produced by an analytics agent unless it references a valid, authority-signed tasking. A cue against a U.S. person on U.S. soil is always rejected absent explicit legal authorization.

doctrines.name: Destructive Command Against Sovereign Data Store or Audit Trail
doctrines.description: Rejects destructive shell commands that would wipe operational evidence or the hash-chained audit trail outside the governed, receipted retention-purge workflow.

doctrines.name: Audit Logging Bypass
doctrines.description: Detects flags or intent that would suppress an operation from landing in the hash-chained ledger and SQLite audit vault, defeating sovereign auditability.

doctrines.name: Unencrypted Transit of Classified Data Across Domains
doctrines.description: Rejects movement of classified or U.S.-person data across NIPR/SIPR/Mission-Partner network boundaries over plaintext protocols.
